answer: Bind each agent to one carrier eSIM. The carrier verified the subscriber with an ID check when it sold the line, so one person gets one profile. The agent asks for an attestation, the carrier matches the live SIM to its record, and the token dies after 24 hours. A fake identity costs a new prepaid line, about 10 dollars plus a 5 dollar fee and a fresh ID check, so 1,000 fakes cost 15,000 dollars before earning a cent. Paid work is the nectar, and a sybil farm is yarrow from one root: pull the root, the patch dies, and the jade seal on each real agent stays put.
